description: Add an --upper flag to a small CLI (multi-file feature)
prompt: This small CLI prints a greeting: `node cli.js World` prints "Hello, World!". Add support for an `--upper` flag anywhere in the arguments that makes the greeting uppercase: `node cli.js --upper World` must print "HELLO, WORLD!". Keep the default behaviour unchanged, and implement the transformation in format.js (not inline in cli.js).
verify: test "$(node cli.js World)" = 'Hello, World!' && test "$(node cli.js --upper World)" = 'HELLO, WORLD!' && test "$(node cli.js World --upper)" = 'HELLO, WORLD!'
